severity_ensemble: Equal mean of three seed probability vectors within each arm/stage
scope: Reused development validation; epoch selection and assessment share this cohort

training_protocol.selection: Overall RSNA VAL macro-F1; earliest epoch wins ties
training_protocol.trained_layers: All MLP layers; encoder remains frozen
training_protocol.class_weighting: Inverse-square-root frequency; RSNA TRAIN paired cohort only

bootstrap.method: Paired patient-level percentile bootstrap; both levels stay together
bootstrap.limitations: Intervals condition on these fitted models and this cohort. They do not measure label uncertainty, training-data variation, new-site generalization, or clinical validity. A family mean is not an ensemble. Macro-F1 uses fixed classes [0,1,2], zero F1 for an absent class.
